criteria.original_task: Compare M7 flash08000000/RAM20000000 with M4 flash08100000/RAM30000000 and shared30040000.
criteria.original_expected: Private images must not overlap and shared access is a memory-master fact; M7 TCM is not automatically M4-accessible. Existing build reserves private ranges and checks static storage plus handler stack.

changed_conditions.task: Move shared data to a different SRAM/power domain and revisit both linker and bus-access premises.

criteria.evidence_scope: Native range/owner ledger plus actual separate ELF placement; no bus observation.

criteria.original_task: Build both images with their actual core flags and inspect every undefined/link dependency.
criteria.original_expected: Two successful ELF links establish code/placement evidence only. No libgcc, libc, libatomic, HAL or OpenAMP may silently implement target mechanisms; original runtime helpers need inspection.

changed_conditions.task: Enable an operation that introduces an implicit helper and either implement/audit it or reject the dependency explicitly.

criteria.evidence_scope: Actual objects, linked maps and intentional unresolved-helper rejection.

criteria.original_task: Assign one owner for each clock/peripheral and diagnose both cores initializing one device.
criteria.original_expected: A common register address does not confer coordinated ownership. Conflicting initialization can destroy another core state; an ownership table must include shared clock/reset operations.

changed_conditions.task: Move telemetry ownership to M4 and derive changed interrupts, peripheral access and resource costs before any authorized physical run.

criteria.evidence_scope: Ownership derivation and actual selected bank/model/task-placement checks.

criteria.original_task: Replay shared ready/ack from a previous boot while protocol layout changed.
criteria.original_expected: Ready alone is insufficient: match layout/version and fresh incarnation before access. Retained board.c uses magic plus epoch1 and global reset premises; it is not general negotiation.

changed_conditions.task: Change one payload field width and require rejection before either image reads the changed layout.

criteria.evidence_scope: Concrete stale-prefix/layout tests and target static ABI checks.

criteria.original_task: Delay M4 indefinitely after M7 release and compare each core wait path.
criteria.original_expected: M4 has a bounded spin count; M7 service returns while ack differs and has no bounded handshake failure policy. Add an elapsed-time state/terminal result without mistaking spins for milliseconds.

changed_conditions.task: Use an independently wrapping monotonic timer and prove the admitted timeout interval bound.

criteria.evidence_scope: Checked wrap arithmetic and compiled bounded wait paths; no physical timer calibration.

criteria.original_task: Reset only M4 after publication while M7 survives.
criteria.original_expected: Do not clear shared state from both cores or reaccept old epoch1. Establish trusted quiescence, new nonwrapping epoch and explicit uncertainty; cold reset code does not implement this.

changed_conditions.task: Interrupt recovery after every publication stage and derive idempotent restart or fail-stop outcomes.

criteria.evidence_scope: Actual header transitions, native pending-work classification and single-core emulated rendezvous; no physical reset execution.

criteria.original_task: Let uint32 head1 and tailFFFFFFFE with capacity16; then add a second producer.
criteria.original_expected: Bounded modular distance is3, but single-writer ownership is essential. A second producer can reserve the same slot even if every index access is individually atomic.

changed_conditions.task: Batch four records and prove all payload bytes precede one admitted publication without overwriting unread slots.

criteria.evidence_scope: C17 ownership argument plus real single-producer/single-consumer threads, not an all-interleaving proof.

criteria.original_task: Move head publication before payload stores and compare volatile with barrier semantics.
criteria.original_expected: Volatile access alone supplies neither ISO C thread synchronization nor a full inter-image device memory contract. The target uses selected compiler/Arm barriers and noncacheable placement; explain both layers.

changed_conditions.task: Compile at changed optimization and inspect emitted ordering while retaining source-level ownership obligations.

criteria.evidence_scope: Finite event counterexample and actual compiler ordering artifacts.

criteria.original_task: Fill16 slots, reject the next packet, then wrap and drain numbered records.
criteria.original_expected: Accepted messages preserve sequence; rejected submission changes no unread slot. Epoch and sequence are separate checks; host ordering tests do not establish board cache behavior.

changed_conditions.task: Use bounded variable-length messages and reject insufficient receive capacity without consuming the next record.

criteria.evidence_scope: Actual C queue/payload behavior; physical caches remain separate.

criteria.original_task: Publish three packets while notification is masked, then observe one pending interrupt.
criteria.original_expected: The queue contains three accepted records even if interrupt count isone. Drain authoritative head/tail state; IRQ count cannot be a message count.

changed_conditions.task: Mask/rearm at every empty-check boundary and show either a visible queue or a guaranteed wake.

criteria.evidence_scope: Exact coalescing/rearm register model and task service code; no silicon interrupt timing.

criteria.original_task: Attempt HSEM release after a failed ownership readback; clear the wrong core interrupt bank.
criteria.original_expected: Only the matching core/process owner may release; wrong-bank acknowledgement cannot establish notification completion. Verify selected source offsets and exact board contract before target use.

changed_conditions.task: Change the semaphore assignment and derive both producer release and receiver mask/clear paths.

criteria.evidence_scope: Actual adapter function executed against bounded register model; manual offsets and image code separately bound.

criteria.original_task: Compare board.c one-packet service call with a loop draining to empty.
criteria.original_expected: Periodic service can eventually drain despite coalesced IRQs; it is not one-packet-per-interrupt logic. A drain loop needs a work budget so other tasks progress under sustained load.

changed_conditions.task: Choose a bounded drain budget and calculate worst backlog under a declared arrival/service curve.

criteria.evidence_scope: Concrete budget tests and explicit arrival/service algebra; no unstated stability assumption.

criteria.original_task: Round address3004001F length2 to32-byte lines and place unrelated dirty data beside it.
criteria.original_expected: Maintenance range30040000..30040040 covers64 bytes, including unrelated bytes. Alignment of the logical payload alone does not grant ownership of entire affected lines.

changed_conditions.task: Change line width to64 and derive overflow-safe rounding and required allocation isolation.

criteria.evidence_scope: Native overflow/range tests and explicit dirty-neighbor model.

criteria.original_task: Clean after ringing the peer, then substitute DMB for invalidating a stale consumer line.
criteria.original_expected: Notification must follow data visibility; a barrier does not clean or invalidate cache contents. Clean/invalidate direction and ownership are distinct from ordering.

changed_conditions.task: Use a receive buffer dirty before DMA and define pre/post-transfer maintenance without discarding unrelated dirty state.

criteria.evidence_scope: Actual Pd callback order and bounded cache-state counterexample; not physical DMA visibility.

criteria.original_task: Assess the cold noncacheable baseline as evidence for a cached M7/M4 transfer.
criteria.original_expected: It avoids that cache path and cannot prove its correctness. Required cached experiment must record placement, line operations, barriers, checksums and observations; absent hardware remains not-run.

changed_conditions.task: Retain the same protocol on a coherent machine and identify which maintenance steps become unnecessary while ownership still matters.

criteria.evidence_scope: Actual cached-path image construction and coherent/noncoherent premise comparison; no board result.

criteria.original_task: Trace FREE,FILLING,DEVICE,COMPLETED,CONSUMING,FREE and inject struct lr_cpu writes during DEVICE.
criteria.original_expected: Submission transfers exclusive buffer access; a completion interrupt is only evidence to inspect terminal device state and visibility. State labels alone do not implement DMA.

changed_conditions.task: Use ping-pong buffers and derive maximum admitted producer burst without reusing device-owned storage.

criteria.evidence_scope: Concrete ownership adapter and actual linked DMA2 port; native device observations are simulated.

criteria.original_task: Observe timeout and a late completion for an old generation after cancellation.
criteria.original_expected: Timeout is not device quiescence. Preserve storage until trusted stop/completion; an old generation cannot publish success into a new request.

changed_conditions.task: Inject an error completion with valid ownership return and distinguish recyclable storage from successful payload data.

criteria.evidence_scope: Mechanism-specific Pd/Xd completion and visibility checks; no timeout-as-quiescence inference.

criteria.original_task: Place a buffer in inaccessible RAM and compare a host-model pass with target bus behavior.
criteria.original_expected: The memory-master ledger and linker map must prove reachability before submission. Host arrays cannot demonstrate bus access or cache visibility.

changed_conditions.task: Move to another DMA engine and rederive reachable regions, alignment, maximum extent and error flags.

criteria.evidence_scope: Actual selected engine validation plus linked target source; no physical reachability measurement.

criteria.original_task: Subtract M4 counter900 from M7 counter1000 with unrelated clock origins.
criteria.original_expected: The difference100 has no latency meaning without a mapping and uncertainty. Same-core elapsed counts or a common external capture avoid that invalid subtraction.

changed_conditions.task: Fit an offset/rate interval from synchronization exchanges and propagate asymmetric-delay uncertainty.

criteria.evidence_scope: Exact rational interval derivation from declared synthetic exchanges, not measured oscillator calibration.

criteria.original_task: Convert48000 cycles at480MHz and account for32-bit wrap and probe overhead.
criteria.original_expected: Nominal100 microseconds is valid only for that fixed frequency and unambiguous elapsed interval. Subtracting probe cost needs measured bounds and cannot produce negative physical time.

changed_conditions.task: Change frequency during the interval and integrate piecewise rates rather than applying one endpoint frequency.

criteria.evidence_scope: Exact arithmetic and explicit frequency/probe premises; no invented timing sample.

criteria.original_task: Compare an observed maximum over1000 samples with a claimed WCET bound.
criteria.original_expected: A sample maximum and tail distribution are observations, not a universal worst-case guarantee. Record dropped samples, resolution, interference and exact image identity.

changed_conditions.task: Introduce a rare interrupt burst and reassess the measurement design rather than presenting the old average.

criteria.evidence_scope: Finite counterexample plus actual emulated interference execution, not a physical WCET observation.

criteria.original_task: A peer performs an effect then resets before its reply; timeout fires.
criteria.original_expected: Outcome is uncertain, not proof of no effect. Replaying without durable/application deduplication can repeat it; transport epoch only rejects stale transport identities.

changed_conditions.task: Make a command idempotent by operation ID and state what persists across peer versus full-machine reset.

criteria.evidence_scope: Actual application receipt transition/cut tests with explicit retention horizon.

criteria.original_task: Restart epoch1 to2, reuse sequence1 and deliver ACK(1,1) beforeACK(2,1).
criteria.original_expected: The old ACK cannot complete the new request. Nonwrapping epoch exhaustion and trusted quiescence precede storage reuse; the additive model does not provide actual reset control.

changed_conditions.task: Pause recovery after reset observation but before new readiness and prove no application traffic is admitted.

criteria.evidence_scope: Concrete epoch/gate and per-record stale-ack checks; physical reset authority not inferred.

criteria.original_task: Compare board.c mismatch fail-stop with a claimed warm recovery demonstration.
criteria.original_expected: Fail-stop detects a fault but does not recover shared ownership or reconcile results. Require new state machine, reset/ready trace and source/image hashes for the stronger claim.

changed_conditions.task: Recover only one peer while survivor has queued work and classify every item completed, rejected or uncertain.

criteria.evidence_scope: Actual single-core emulated drained rendezvous and separate native pending-work recovery model.

criteria.original_task: Use hop costs10,20,30 microseconds and queues2,4,8 with no interference.
criteria.original_expected: Uncontended cost sum60 and total slots14 do not bound queued or preempted response time. Every hop needs its own capacity and overload/ownership policy.

changed_conditions.task: Add a downstream pause longer than upstream capacity and derive exactly which sequence IDs reject or remain retained.

criteria.evidence_scope: Executable event schedule and actual bounded task queue composition; costs are explicit model premises.

criteria.original_task: Perform parsing in the acquisition ISR while M7 high-priority compute delays response.
criteria.original_expected: Unbounded ISR work compromises local scheduling; priority on one core cannot by itself bound delay on the other. Move bounded messages to task context.

changed_conditions.task: Inject high-priority interrupts on M4 only and locate the first accumulating queue from an end-to-end ledger.

criteria.evidence_scope: Actual interrupt/task separation plus explicit per-stage interference schedules; no cross-core measured bound.

criteria.original_task: Reconcile100 accepted inputs with90 completions,5 declared drops and5 outstanding across a reset.
criteria.original_expected: The ledger balances only if outstanding ownership and epoch are recorded; throughput averages cannot hide those five. Cross-clock timestamps need calibration.

changed_conditions.task: Move one stage to the other core and recompute traffic, queue occupancy and interference before comparing performance.

criteria.evidence_scope: Exact accepted-input ledger and actual same-correctness moved-task experiment.

criteria.original_task: Match ELF/source hashes, shared layout and board revision before interpreting success markers.
criteria.original_expected: A marker from a different image or layout cannot validate current source. Cross-build proves neither flashed identity nor physical parallel progress.

changed_conditions.task: Change optimization and regenerate maps/disassembly and actual run evidence while preserving prior historical receipts.

criteria.evidence_scope: Source-bound native/image/emulator receipts and immutable attempts.

criteria.original_task: Run periodic acquisition, parallel compute, bounded overload and peer restart under one resource ledger.
criteria.original_expected: Account for both private images and shared storage, accepted/rejected/completed/uncertain messages, struct lr_cpu/I/O costs and measurement uncertainty. Cold1000-packet success alone omits required fault paths.

changed_conditions.task: Move the compute service while keeping equal correctness and workload contracts, then explain changed resource costs.

criteria.evidence_scope: Actual source composition, separate dual-image audit and single-core machine execution.

criteria.original_task: No board is available but all hosted and image gates pass.
criteria.original_expected: Record physicalnot-run explicitly; retain useful narrower evidence and provide the executable experiment/instrumentation plan. Neither a simulation nor a text report closes physical mastery.

changed_conditions.task: After later authorized board access, execute the exact source-bound experiment and identify assumptions falsified by actual traces.

criteria.evidence_scope: Prepared board experiment and strict missing-evidence rejection; no physical or independent learner completion.
